item.title: ChatGPT Chat, Work, and Dot
item.description:
The blog is generated by ChatGPT.

OpenAI’s ChatGPT has evolved beyond a conversational AI assistant. It now offers three distinct experiences: Chat, Work, and Dot, each designed for a different way of interacting with AI.

At a high level:

  • Chat: Think with AI.
  • Work: Delegate tasks to AI.
  • Dot: Pursue long-term goals with AI.

These experiences illustrate a broader evolution in AI systems: from answering questions, to executing tasks, to pursuing ongoing objectives.

1. Chat vs. Work vs. Dot — At a Glance

Dimension Chat Work Dot
Primary role AI assistant Task-execution agent Persistent agent
Main objective Answer and assist Complete delegated tasks Advance ongoing goals
Interaction style Conversational Task-oriented Goal-oriented
Reasoning Yes Yes Yes
Tool use Supported Supported Supported
Computer use Not its primary interface Cloud/local computer Dedicated cloud computer
Memory ChatGPT Memory Project/task context Persistent, evolving memory
Background execution Through supported tasks Yes Yes
Scheduled execution Supported Supported Supported
Proactive behavior Limited, task-dependent Primarily instructed or scheduled Core design goal
Typical outcome Answers and insights Finished deliverables Ongoing progress

These distinctions are conceptual rather than absolute. Chat can perform sophisticated research, Work can execute recurring tasks, and Dot can answer ordinary questions.
